blindComparison: No blind comparison was performed. The reviewer knows these source files and cannot determine which anonymous work an evaluator would prefer. This report does not mark any product element satisfied.
browserStatus: Saved runtime report records passed; reviewer launched no browser.
limitations: No browser was launched by this reviewer. The later saved CI report records a successful WebKit run; the reviewer checked its metadata and PNG hashes, but did not visually judge the images or independently verify remote CI provenance.

A paused browser compositor may retain a previous canvas frame. Two animation callbacks and separate screenshots do not establish byte correspondence with the synchronous native PNG. Inspect runtime images as separate surfaces.
Positive draw/triangle counts establish submitted rendering work, not correct or nonblank pixels. The captures must be inspected.

The engine frame counter advances on rendering. Grounded is the production flag and teleport initializes it true; normal simulation updates it during the wait. The helper does not independently trace collision contacts or establish a route playthrough.
Only #ui display is temporarily hidden. The helper intentionally changes gameplay state through new game and teleport, and it does not restore the prior save, actor/camera pose or engine clock.
The eight still views cannot establish animation, combat or movement feel, interiors, physical smartphone behavior, reference-work equivalence, or any overall satisfied verdict.
nativeResolutionMeaning: Decoded native PNG dimensions independently checked for all 8 saved CI captures. The configured CSS viewport is 667x375.
profile: Read-only source review, Node execution of actual settings/tier APIs and authored spawn generation, then inspection of saved CI metadata and native-PNG hashes. The reviewer did not launch a browser.
reviewedTree: mobile_visual_capture.mjs and integration were committed; src/game/game.js had unrelated in-progress edits. Per-file hashes identify the exact reviewed sources.
scoreMeaning: The bounded source review has no surviving defect within the terminal CI helper contract. This is not a product-quality, browser-performance or blind-comparison score.
verified: Both modified instrument modules pass node --check.
The eight VIEWS entries resolve in the actual buildHollisData() result: start, marrow_west, arcade_out, cinder_road, survey_out, ventfield, south_marrow, plant_out.

The integrated call follows exerciseBackdrop. The preceding layout helper removes its pause reason and restores preferences; backdrop restores the current ground geometry, UI display and running state in finally.

waitFrames reads the actual engine.frame counter and requires a further 12 rendered frames. The helper also requires frame >= placed.frame+12; this is not a claim of exactly 12 fixed simulation steps.
New game and authored-spawn teleport are expressly disclosed setup. Yaw/pitch use the real third-person camera; game.render(0) updates the actual camera, visibility, atmosphere and postprocessing.
The native PNG is copied in the same JavaScript turn as game.render(0). Its file and decoded RGBA hashes and dimensions are recorded. Later viewport and HUD screenshots are separate evidence.
The checks fail for non-PLAY/paused/non-medium state, hidden/dead/ungrounded/nonpositive-health player, nonfinite captured poses, insufficient frame progression, or zero submitted draws/triangles.

Inner finally restores #ui display and restarts the engine after file/PNG/screenshot failures. Render/toDataURL exceptions restart the engine before propagating. These are source-level cleanup checks, not browser fault-injection results.
All helper failures propagate to the main report failure list; no subsequent play test consumes its intentionally reset gameplay state.

acceptedLimitations.observation: Restoring the original auto quality setting leaves the actual engine tier at medium. Entry auto+low and auto+high both exited auto+medium; only auto+medium returned to its original tier.

evidence.substitutes: Document style/class methods and an in-memory localStorage; actual production Game.applySettings and Engine.setTier

acceptedLimitations.independentRefutation: The coordinator independently confirmed the intended terminal-helper contract: original settings are restored, but prior gameplay state/position and the prior auto-selected tier are not. The CI page closes after the helper, so no subsequent measurements inherit that tier.
acceptedLimitations.disposition: The tier difference is recorded as an explicit cleanup limit, not an implementation defect or reason to add optional restoration work.

runtimeArtifactObservation.identityBoundary: The coordinator identified this as the 3266b95 CI artifact. This reviewer verified the saved report and image bytes, but did not independently check remote CI run provenance; report.json does not embed the git commit.
runtimeArtifactObservation.checks: All 8 native PNGs decode to 1147x645 and match both the PNG SHA-256 and decoded-RGBA SHA-256 in the report. All 8 viewport and all 8 HUD paths also exist.
runtimeArtifactObservation.inference: The stored captures and recorded states are internally consistent with execution of the reviewed helper. This does not establish image quality, collision-contact accuracy or a played route.
